title.zh-CN: 打针后臀部肿痛、瘀斑扩大 · 51岁男性
title.en: Painful buttock swelling and a spreading bruise after an injection · 51-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 一位做过心脏瓣膜手术的男性，打针后臀部越来越肿、青紫一天天扩大：在病房接诊，查明原因，决定先做什么，并跟进此后几天的病程。
summary.en: A man who has had heart-valve surgery develops a swelling buttock and a spreading bruise after an injection: see him on the ward, work out the cause, decide what comes first and follow the next days of his course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别华法林抗凝过度（INR 6.2）时肌注部位出血形成的血肿——打针次日起病、瘀斑逐日扩大、Hb 86 g/L、超声见内含絮状回声的低回声区——把脓肿留在鉴别中，但在 INR 纠正之前不对积液动针动刀。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise a haematoma from bleeding at an intramuscular injection site on excessive warfarin (INR 6.2) — onset the day after the injection, a bruise spreading daily, an Hb of 86 g/L and a hypoechoic area with flocculent echoes — keeping an abscess in the differential but putting no needle into the collection while the INR is uncorrected.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 ACC 2020 共识判断出血严重程度并相应逆转华法林：停药，静脉缓慢输注维生素K₁ 5–10 mg，按 INR 和体重给4因子PCC（没有PCC时才用血浆），绝不肌注维生素K，引流前复查 INR（ACC 2020；CHEST 2012）。
learningOutcomes.en: Classify an anticoagulant-related bleed by the ACC 2020 criteria and reverse warfarin to match: stop it, give vitamin K₁ 5–10 mg by slow IV infusion with 4-factor PCC dosed by INR and weight (plasma only when there is no PCC), never IM vitamin K, and recheck the INR before drainage (ACC 2020; CHEST 2012).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 AABB 2023 的限制性阈值和 NICE NG24（2015）每次 1 单位、输后复评的原则，为瓣膜病患者输注红细胞，预防输血相关循环超负荷。
learningOutcomes.en: Transfuse red cells for a patient with valve disease by the AABB 2023 restrictive thresholds and the NICE NG24 (2015) one-unit-then-review approach, guarding against transfusion-associated circulatory overload.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按 ISBT 2018 定义识别输血后新出现的气短中可能的循环超负荷：停止继续输血、评估、吸氧、利尿、上报，并排除输血相关急性肺损伤、过敏反应和人工瓣膜问题。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise possible circulatory overload in new breathlessness after a transfusion by the ISBT 2018 definition — stop further transfusion, assess, give oxygen and a diuretic, report — while excluding lung injury, allergy and prosthetic-valve problems.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为人工瓣膜患者规划出血后的抗凝恢复：核实瓣膜类型和目标 INR，止血可靠后尽早恢复，机械二尖瓣以肝素过渡，机械瓣不用直接口服抗凝药（ACC 2020；ACC/AHA 2020）；并以不超过 CHEST 2012 上限的 INR 监测间隔、INR 高于范围时不肌注（NHS SPS 2023）预防再次出血。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the restart of anticoagulation after a bleed in a patient with prosthetic valves — confirm the valve type and target INR, restart as soon as haemostasis is secure, bridge a mechanical mitral valve with heparin and never use a DOAC with a mechanical valve (ACC 2020; ACC/AHA 2020) — and prevent a repeat with INR checks no further apart than CHEST 2012 allows and no IM injection above range (NHS SPS 2023).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用 Calgary–Cambridge 的解释与计划方法和复述确认，向担心瓣膜的患者说明出血的原因、暂停和逆转华法林的理由，以及恢复抗凝的计划。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the bleed, the pause in warfarin and the plan to restart it to a patient who fears for his valves, using the Calgary–Cambridge explanation-and-planning steps and teach-back.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——51岁男性，5 年前行主动脉瓣和二尖瓣置换，此后长期口服华法林，约半年查一次凝血、既往结果未带来；感冒时肌注安乃近，8 天前打针、次日起不适、疼痛 6 天，瘀斑逐日扩大，躺坐时疼痛加重；无家族遗传病史；左臀、部分右臀及左腰暗红色瘀斑，左臀约 150×50 mm 压痛肿块、局部稍热；INR 6.2、APTT 42.5 s，Hb 86 g/L、RBC 2.7×10¹²/L、WBC 24.7×10⁹/L；臀部超声皮下约 36 mm 深处约 139×55 mm 不规则低回声区、内有絮状回声；逆转（1.0.0 版教学文字描述为大剂量维生素K）后引流见血凝块而非脓液，术后 Hb 58 g/L，输血后胸闷气短考虑心衰、治疗后缓解，此后恢复华法林，1 个月瘀斑消退、INR 2.1——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计（入院、引流术后、输血之后、记录的结局）、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色以及患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、血小板、瓣膜类型、目标 INR、华法林和安乃近剂量、逆转的具体药物和剂量、输血量、心衰的检查和治疗、恢复华法林的时间）保持未知。1.0.0 版内部的一处时间差异（“8 天前打针、次日开始不适”与“已经痛了 6 天”）保留并列入导师指南的待核实清单。本例没有获准展示的原图。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 51-year-old man on long-term warfarin since aortic and mitral valve replacements 5 years earlier, with clotting checked about every six months and earlier results not available; an intramuscular metamizole injection for a cold 8 days before, symptoms from the next day, pain for 6 days, a bruise spreading daily and pain worse lying or sitting; no inherited family disease; dark-red bruising over the left buttock, part of the right buttock and the left waist, and a tender, mildly warm left-buttock mass of about 150×50 mm; INR 6.2, APTT 42.5 s, Hb 86 g/L, RBC 2.7×10¹²/L, WBC 24.7×10⁹/L; a buttock ultrasound with an irregular hypoechoic area of about 139×55 mm about 36 mm beneath the skin, with flocculent echoes; drainage after reversal (described in the 1.0.0 teaching text as high-dose vitamin K) finding clot rather than pus, a post-operative Hb of 58 g/L, breathlessness after a transfusion considered heart failure and improving with treatment, warfarin resumed, and at one month the bruising resolved with an INR of 2.1 — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The staging (admission, after the drainage, after the transfusion, the recorded outcome), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (teaching devices that add no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, platelets, the valve type, the target INR, the warfarin and metamizole doses, the reversal agents and doses, the volume transfused, the investigation and treatment of the heart failure, when warfarin restarted) stays unknown. One point where the 1.0.0 text differs with itself (an injection 8 days before with symptoms from the next day, against pain for 6 days) is kept and listed in the facilitator guide's “To verify”. No figure of the report is approved for display.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 左边屁股肿痛，青紫越来越大
chiefComplaint.en: My left buttock is swollen and sore, and the bruise keeps spreading

triageNote.zh-CN: 51岁男性，今天收入病房：8 天前打过一针，之后左臀部肿痛，瘀斑一天天扩大。
triageNote.en: A 51-year-old man admitted to the ward today: after an injection 8 days ago his left buttock became swollen and painful, and the bruise over it has spread day by day.

personality.zh-CN: 51岁男性，5 年前换过心脏瓣膜，一直吃华法林。左边屁股肿痛了好些天，青紫越来越大，躺着坐着都疼，心里着急，但说话清楚、愿意配合。只说自己知道的事；不知道的就直说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 51-year-old man who had heart valves replaced 5 years ago and takes warfarin. His left buttock has been swollen and sore for days, the bruise keeps growing and lying or sitting hurts; he is worried but clear and cooperative. He says only what he knows; when he does not know, he says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语，句子短，不用医学术语；说得出的药名只有“华法林”和“安乃近”。
speechStyle.en: Plain, short sentences without medical terms; the only drug names he uses are warfarin and metamizole.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我左边屁股又肿又疼，那块青紫还在往外扩。
openingLine.en: Doctor, my left buttock's swollen and sore, and the bruise is still spreading.

concerns.zh-CN: 华法林要是停了，我换的瓣膜会不会出事？
concerns.en: If the warfarin is stopped, will something happen to my new valves?
Did that injection do me harm?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院时他躺着、坐着都疼，不停地换姿势，说话清楚、配合。输血之后那一阶段，他胸口发闷、气短，回答变短。他不说任何数字或化验结果，不编造病史、用药、剂量、过敏或体重。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: on admission lying and sitting both hurt, so he keeps shifting position; he speaks clearly and cooperates. In the stage after the transfusion his chest feels tight and he is short of breath, so his answers get shorter. He never gives numbers or test results and never invents history, medicines, doses, allergies or weight.

label.en: Admission: a swollen, painful left buttock

description.zh-CN: 他今天因左臀部肿痛、瘀斑一天天扩大收入病房。你在床旁：问诊、查体、开立检查，判断原因，决定先做什么。
description.en: He has been admitted today with a swollen, painful left buttock and a bruise that has spread day by day. At the bedside: take the history, examine him, order tests, work out the cause and decide what comes first.

description.zh-CN: 按记录的病程，华法林的作用被逆转之后，臀部的积液在手术中做了引流。他已回到病房。
description.en: In the recorded course, the warfarin effect was reversed and the collection was then drained at an operation. He is back on the ward.

description.zh-CN: 术后他接受了输血。输血之后，你再次到床旁看他。
description.en: After the operation he was given a blood transfusion. After the transfusion you see him again at the bedside.

description.zh-CN: 此后的治疗经过和 1 个月时的复查：本病例记录的结局。
description.en: What happened next and the review at one month, as this case records them.

text.zh-CN: 华法林的作用被逆转后（所用维生素K描述为大剂量，剂量未记录）行手术引流，引流出血凝块而非脓液。术后血红蛋白降至 58 g/L，予输血；输血后出现胸闷、气短，被考虑为心力衰竭，经治疗后缓解。此后恢复服用华法林。1 个月时瘀斑消退，INR 2.1。
text.en: After the warfarin effect had been reversed (with vitamin K described as high-dose; the dose is not recorded), the collection was drained at an operation: it contained blood clot, not pus. After the operation the haemoglobin fell to 58 g/L and he was transfused; after the transfusion he became tight-chested and short of breath, which was considered heart failure and improved with treatment. Warfarin was later resumed. At one month the bruising had resolved and the INR was 2.1.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录逆转所用的全部药物和剂量、输血的种类和量、气短时的检查和治疗、恢复华法林的时间和剂量、是否用肝素过渡，以及 1 个月以后的随访。
note.en: This case does not record every reversal agent and dose, the blood product and amount transfused, the tests and treatment during the breathlessness, when and at what dose warfarin was restarted, whether heparin bridged the gap, or any follow-up after one month.

response.zh-CN: 凝血酶原复合物开始输注。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The PCC is running. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 10–15 mL/kg 静脉输注，仅在没有凝血酶原复合物时使用；注意容量负荷。
dose.en: 10–15 mL/kg IV, only when no PCC is available; watch the volume load.

response.zh-CN: 血浆开始输注。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。血浆容量大、纠正比PCC慢，瓣膜病患者要警惕循环超负荷。
response.en: The plasma is running. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect. Its volume is large and the correction slower than with PCC — watch for circulatory overload in valve disease.

dose.zh-CN: 维生素K₁ 10 mg 肌内注射。

harm.zh-CN: 不要肌注：他这次的问题正是 INR 过高时肌注部位出血形成的血肿。INR 6.2 时再肌注一针，可能在新的部位出血；肌注吸收也不稳定，起效不可靠（NHS SPS 2023：INR 高于治疗范围时不应肌注）。维生素K₁应缓慢静脉输注，出血时同时给PCC（ACC 2020）。
harm.en: Not into the muscle: his problem is exactly a haematoma at an IM injection site on an INR above range. Another IM injection at an INR of 6.2 can bleed at a new site, and absorption from muscle is erratic (NHS SPS 2023: no IM injection when the INR is above the therapeutic range). Give vitamin K₁ by slow IV infusion, with PCC while he is bleeding (ACC 2020).

response.en: Vitamin K₁ has been given intramuscularly.

name.en: Bedside needle aspiration or incision of the swelling

dose.zh-CN: 在床旁用粗针穿刺抽吸，或切开排出积液。
dose.en: Aspirate with a wide-bore needle at the bedside, or incise and let the collection drain.

harm.zh-CN: 不要在床旁动针动刀：INR 6.2 时穿刺或切开一个约 139×55 mm 的积液区，可能让仍在进行的出血失去控制，还可能带入感染。有没有脓、要不要引流，要在凝血纠正、复查 INR 之后，由外科在影像引导下或在手术中处理（ACC 2020：先控制出血、逆转抗凝）。
harm.en: No needle or blade at the bedside: aspirating or incising a collection of about 139×55 mm at an INR of 6.2 can turn an ongoing bleed into an uncontrolled one and can bring in infection. Whether there is pus, and whether to drain, is for the surgeons under imaging or at operation once the INR is corrected and rechecked (ACC 2020: control the bleeding and reverse the anticoagulant first).

name.en: Ask the surgeons to drain the collection in theatre

dose.zh-CN: 凝血纠正、复查 INR 之后，由外科评估并在手术室引流；引流物送检（包括培养）。
dose.en: Once the clotting is corrected and the INR rechecked, the surgeons assess and drain the collection in theatre, sending the contents for testing, culture included.

harm.zh-CN: 还不能送去引流：还没有补充凝血因子，最近一次 INR 是 6.2，也没有复查结果证明已经纠正。维生素K单用需要数小时才起效、约一天才充分；先给PCC（没有PCC时用血浆）加静脉维生素K，复查 INR 确认纠正后再手术（ACC 2020）。
harm.en: Not yet: no clotting factors have been replaced, and the last INR was 6.2 with no repeat to show correction. Vitamin K alone takes hours to act and about a day for its full effect; give PCC (plasma if there is none) with IV vitamin K and confirm correction on a repeat INR before the operation (ACC 2020).

response.zh-CN: 外科同意评估并安排手术引流。本病例记录，臀部的积液是在华法林的作用被逆转之后引流的。
response.en: The surgeons accept him for assessment and drainage in theatre. This case records that the collection was drained after the warfarin effect had been reversed.

name.zh-CN: 口服对乙酰氨基酚止痛

dose.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚 0.5–1 g 口服，必要时每 6 小时一次，每日不超过 4 g（肝病、低体重或大量饮酒者减量）；规律服用可使 INR 升高，需要监测。
dose.en: Paracetamol 0.5–1 g orally up to every 6 hours as needed, no more than 4 g a day (less with liver disease, low weight or heavy drinking); regular use can raise the INR, so monitor it.

response.zh-CN: 已口服对乙酰氨基酚。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Paracetamol has been given by mouth. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 双氯芬酸肌内注射止痛
name.en: Diclofenac intramuscular injection for the pain

dose.zh-CN: 双氯芬酸 75 mg 臀部深部肌内注射。
dose.en: Diclofenac 75 mg by deep intramuscular injection into the buttock.

harm.zh-CN: 不要：这既是又一次肌内注射（INR 高于治疗范围时不应肌注，NHS SPS 2023），又是一种非甾体抗炎药——抑制血小板、损伤胃黏膜，与华法林合用会增加出血。止痛用口服对乙酰氨基酚。
harm.en: No: this is both another intramuscular injection (none while the INR is above range, NHS SPS 2023) and an NSAID, which impairs platelets and the stomach lining and adds to the bleeding risk of warfarin. Use oral paracetamol for the pain.

response.en: Diclofenac has been injected into the muscle.

name.zh-CN: 悬浮红细胞输注（每次 1 单位，输后复评）
name.en: Red cell transfusion, one unit at a time with review

dose.zh-CN: 每次 1 单位，按医院输血规范的速度输注并观察生命体征；每单位输完后评估症状、液体平衡和 Hb，再决定下一单位。
dose.en: One unit at a time at the rate the hospital's transfusion policy sets, with its observations; reassess symptoms, fluid balance and Hb after each unit before the next.

response.zh-CN: 第 1 单位红细胞开始输注。本病例记录术后输了血，但没有记录血制品的种类、单位数和输注速度。
response.en: The first unit of red cells is running. This case records a transfusion after the operation but not the product, the number of units or the rate.

name.zh-CN: 快速连续输注 4 单位红细胞
name.en: Four units of red cells in quick succession

dose.zh-CN: 4 单位悬浮红细胞，加快速度连续输完，目标 Hb > 100 g/L。
dose.en: Four units of red cells run in back to back, aiming for an Hb above 100 g/L.

harm.zh-CN: 不要：没有活动性大出血时快速大量输血，最容易让有瓣膜病的患者发生输血相关循环超负荷。AABB 2023 推荐限制性输血（一般 Hb < 70 g/L，合并心血管病时可用 80 g/L），并不以 100 g/L 为目标；NICE NG24 建议没有活动性出血时每次 1 单位、输后复评。
harm.en: No: a rapid, large transfusion without major active bleeding is the surest way to overload the circulation of a man with valve disease. AABB 2023 recommends a restrictive strategy (generally Hb < 70 g/L; 80 g/L may be used with cardiovascular disease), not a target of 100 g/L, and NICE NG24 advises one unit at a time with review when there is no active bleeding.

response.zh-CN: 4 单位红细胞开始快速输注。
response.en: Four units are being run in quickly.

name.en: Stop the transfusion and check the unit

dose.zh-CN: 若仍在输血，立即停止并保留静脉通路；原因明确前不再输下一单位；核对患者身份与血袋，通知输血科，并按输血不良反应流程处理和上报。
dose.en: If a unit is still running, stop it at once and keep the IV line; give no further units until the cause is clear; check the patient's identity against the unit, inform the blood bank and follow and report the transfusion-reaction procedure.

response.zh-CN: 已停止继续输血，静脉通路保留，血袋已核对并通知输血科。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Further transfusion is stopped, the line kept open, the unit checked and the blood bank informed. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 鼻导管或面罩给氧，按血氧饱和度调节，目标 94–98%。
dose.en: By nasal cannula or mask, titrated to an SpO₂ of 94–98 %.

response.zh-CN: 已开始吸氧。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Oxygen is on. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 呋塞米 20–40 mg 静脉注射（平时服用利尿剂者可用更高剂量），按尿量、症状和血压决定是否重复；监测电解质和肾功能。
dose.en: Furosemide 20–40 mg IV (more if he already takes a diuretic), repeated according to urine output, symptoms and blood pressure; monitor electrolytes and renal function.

response.zh-CN: 呋塞米已静脉注射。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Furosemide has been given IV. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 止血可靠后恢复抗凝（机械瓣以肝素过渡）
name.en: Restart anticoagulation once haemostasis is secure (heparin bridge for mechanical valves)

dose.zh-CN: 先核实瓣膜类型和目标 INR；若为机械瓣，止血可靠后用普通肝素（不推注）或低分子肝素过渡，同时恢复华法林，INR 达标后停用肝素；恢复初期每周至少查 1 次 INR。
dose.en: First confirm the valve type and target INR; if mechanical, once haemostasis is secure, cover with unfractionated heparin (no bolus) or low-molecular-weight heparin while warfarin restarts, stopping the heparin once the INR is in range; check the INR at least weekly at first.

harm.zh-CN: 现在不行：瘀斑还在扩大、INR 6.2，此时恢复抗凝只会加重出血。先停药、逆转、控制出血；止血可靠后再尽早恢复（ACC 2020）。
harm.en: Not now: the bruise is still spreading and the INR is 6.2, so restarting anticoagulation would only feed the bleeding. Stop, reverse and control the bleeding first; restart as soon as haemostasis is secure (ACC 2020).

response.zh-CN: 恢复抗凝的计划已下达。本病例没有记录恢复华法林的时间、剂量以及是否用肝素过渡；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The plan to restart anticoagulation is written. This case does not record when warfarin was restarted, at what dose or whether heparin bridged the gap; it does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Switch to a direct oral anticoagulant

dose.zh-CN: 利伐沙班、阿哌沙班或达比加群，按说明书剂量。
dose.en: Rivaroxaban, apixaban or dabigatran at the labelled dose.

harm.zh-CN: 不要：直接口服抗凝药不能用于机械瓣（ACC/AHA 2020 列为 3 类，有害）——在机械瓣患者中的试验里，血栓栓塞事件多于华法林。先核实瓣膜类型：机械瓣只能用华法林；若是生物瓣，是否需要抗凝取决于其他指征。
harm.en: No: direct oral anticoagulants must not be used with mechanical heart valves (ACC/AHA 2020, class 3: harm) — in trials with mechanical valves they caused more thromboembolic events than warfarin. Confirm the valve type first: a mechanical valve means warfarin; with tissue valves, whether he needs anticoagulation at all depends on other indications.

response.zh-CN: 已开出直接口服抗凝药。
response.en: A direct oral anticoagulant has been prescribed.

name.zh-CN: 抗凝用药教育与随访计划

dose.zh-CN: 讲清楚：INR 至少每 4 周查一次（恢复初期更频繁）；每次看病都告诉医生和药师自己在吃华法林；不接受肌内注射；感冒发热用对乙酰氨基酚，不用止痛针或非甾体抗炎药；任何新药先查相互作用；瘀斑扩大、黑便、尿血、牙龈出血要及时就诊；随身带抗凝卡。
dose.en: Explain: INR at least every 4 weeks (more often at first); tell every doctor and pharmacist he takes warfarin; accept no intramuscular injections; paracetamol, not injections or NSAIDs, for colds and fever; check every new medicine for interactions; seek help for a growing bruise, black stools, blood in the urine or bleeding gums; carry an anticoagulation card.

response.zh-CN: 已向他讲解抗凝注意事项和随访计划。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The anticoagulation advice and follow-up plan have been explained to him. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.en: Ask the clinical pharmacist to review

dose.zh-CN: 请临床药师核对华法林剂量、相互作用、逆转药物的剂量和恢复抗凝的方案。
dose.en: Ask the clinical pharmacist to review the warfarin dose, interactions, the reversal doses and the restart plan.

response.zh-CN: 临床药师会来床旁和你一起核对用药。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The clinical pharmacist will come to review the medicines with you. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清肿痛的来龙去脉和长期用药
title.en: Find out how the swelling began and what he takes

hint.zh-CN: 这块青紫和肿块是在什么之后出现的、又是怎样变化的？他长期吃什么药、为什么吃、多久查一次？
hint.en: What came before the bruise and the swelling, and how have they changed? What does he take long-term, why, and how often is it checked?

guidance.en: Take the history from him at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 检查臀部，拿到第一批结果
title.en: Examine the buttock and get the first results

hint.zh-CN: 瘀斑的范围，肿块的大小、压痛和皮温，各说明什么？哪几项检查能告诉你出血的倾向、失血的多少和肿块里是什么？
hint.en: What do the extent of the bruising and the size, tenderness and warmth of the swelling tell you? Which tests show the bleeding tendency, how much blood has been lost and what the swelling contains?

guidance.zh-CN: 查看双侧臀部和腰部的瘀斑，触诊肿块，开立凝血功能、血常规和臀部超声并查看结果。
guidance.en: Inspect the bruising over the buttocks and the waist, feel the swelling, and order and read the clotting screen, the blood count and the buttock ultrasound.

title.zh-CN: 判断原因，决定先做什么
title.en: Work out the cause and decide what comes first

hint.zh-CN: 他现在最大的危险是什么？最先要改变的是什么？在任何人往肿块里动针动刀之前，必须先做到什么？
hint.en: What is the greatest danger to him right now, and what must change first? What has to be true before anyone puts a needle or a blade into the swelling?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答第 1、2 项决策并开始你选择的处理；准备好以后，再请外科处理积液。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and start the treatment you choose; when he is ready, ask the surgeons to deal with the collection.

title.zh-CN: 此后几天：复查并决定下一步
title.en: The next days: review the results and decide the next step

hint.zh-CN: 引流发现了什么？术后血红蛋白是多少？给这个病人输血时最怕出什么问题，输多少、怎么输？
hint.en: What did the drainage find, and what is the haemoglobin now? What is the main danger in transfusing this man, and how much should he have, and how?

guidance.zh-CN: 在记录终端调阅引流术记录和术后血常规，作答第 3 项决策并开始输血。
guidance.en: Read the drainage operation record and the post-operative blood count at a records terminal, answer decision 3 and start the transfusion.

title.en: Back at the bedside: reassess him

hint.zh-CN: 输血后新出现的气短有哪些可能？在他身上哪一种最可能，哪一种最不能漏？先停什么、先看什么？
hint.en: What can cause new breathlessness after a transfusion? Which is likeliest in him, and which must not be missed? What do you stop, and what do you check first?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问他现在的感受，作答第 4 项决策并开始你选择的处理。
guidance.en: Ask him at the bedside how he feels now, answer decision 4 and start the treatment you choose.

title.zh-CN: 规划以后的用药，对照记录的结局
title.en: Plan his medicines from here and compare with the recorded outcome

hint.zh-CN: 瓣膜类型和目标 INR 怎样决定恢复的时机和方式？这次出血暴露了哪些本可以预防的环节？实际病程和你的计划有哪些不同？
hint.en: How do the valve type and the target INR shape when and how to restart? Which preventable steps did this bleed expose, and where did the recorded course differ from your plan?

guidance.zh-CN: 作答第 5 项决策；随后在记录终端调阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Answer decision 5, then read the recorded course and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 打针后第二天开始，他的左臀部肿痛，瘀斑一天天扩大，现在累及左臀、部分右臀和左腰；左臀可触及约 150×50 mm 的压痛肿块，局部稍热。他 5 年前换过主动脉瓣和二尖瓣，一直吃华法林。INR 6.2，APTT 42.5 s；Hb 86 g/L，WBC 24.7×10⁹/L；超声：皮下约 36 mm 深处约 139×55 mm 的不规则低回声区，内有絮状回声。最可能的解释是什么？
prompt.en: From the day after an injection his left buttock has been swollen and painful, and the bruise has spread daily over the left buttock, part of the right buttock and the left side of the waist; there is a tender mass of about 150×50 mm with mild local warmth. He had aortic and mitral valve replacements 5 years ago and takes warfarin. INR 6.2, APTT 42.5 s; Hb 86 g/L, WBC 24.7×10⁹/L; ultrasound: an irregular hypoechoic area of about 139×55 mm, about 36 mm beneath the skin, with flocculent echoes. What is the most likely explanation?

need.zh-CN: 先问清打针和起病经过、换瓣手术和长期用药，查看瘀斑并触诊肿块（大小、压痛、皮温），再看凝血功能、血常规和臀部超声的结果。
need.en: First take the story of the injection and the onset, the valve surgery and his regular medicines, inspect the bruising and feel the swelling (size, tenderness, warmth), and read the clotting screen, the blood count and the buttock ultrasound.

text.zh-CN: 华法林抗凝过度（INR 6.2）时肌注部位出血，形成臀部血肿，并有失血性贫血
text.en: Bleeding at the injection site on excessive warfarin effect (INR 6.2), forming a buttock haematoma, with blood-loss anaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。打针后第二天起病、瘀斑逐日扩大并延伸到对侧臀部和左腰，加上 INR 6.2、Hb 86 g/L，以及超声上内含絮状回声的不规则低回声区，最符合抗凝过度时注射部位出血形成的血肿。白细胞增高和局部稍热可以见于大血肿，单凭它们不能诊断脓肿。ACC 2020 共识：抗凝患者出血，先判断出血部位和严重程度，再决定停药、逆转和止血措施。
feedback.en: Correct. Onset the day after the injection, a bruise spreading daily to the other buttock and the left waist, an INR of 6.2, an Hb of 86 g/L and an irregular hypoechoic area with flocculent echoes fit bleeding at the injection site on excessive anticoagulation. A raised white count and mild warmth occur with large haematomas and do not by themselves make an abscess. ACC 2020: when an anticoagulated patient bleeds, establish the site and severity first, then decide on stopping, reversal and control of the source.

text.zh-CN: 注射部位脓肿：白细胞 24.7×10⁹/L、局部皮温高和超声里的絮状回声提示积脓
text.en: An injection-site abscess: a WBC of 24.7×10⁹/L, local warmth and flocculent echoes on ultrasound point to pus

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，但要把它留在鉴别里。大血肿本身就可以伴白细胞增高和局部发热；INR 6.2、贫血和超出肿块范围扩散的瘀斑更支持出血。即使怀疑合并感染，也不能在 INR 6.2 时穿刺或切开：先纠正凝血（ACC 2020 共识对需要干预的出血要求逆转华法林），再由外科决定是否引流。
feedback.en: No, but keep it on the list. A large haematoma can itself raise the white count and warm the skin, while an INR of 6.2, anaemia and bruising that tracks beyond the swelling point to bleeding. Even if infection is suspected, no needle or blade goes in at an INR of 6.2: correct the clotting first (ACC 2020 reverses warfarin for bleeding that needs an intervention), then let the surgeons decide on drainage.

text.zh-CN: 腹膜后出血向下蔓延到臀部：左腰瘀斑提示来源在深部，打针只是时间上的巧合
text.en: A retroperitoneal bleed tracking down into the buttock: the waist bruising marks a deep source and the injection is a coincidence

feedback.zh-CN: 不太可能。瘀斑和肿块以左臀为中心，打针次日起病，超声显示积液位于皮下约 36 mm 处，都提示局部来源；左腰的瘀斑更像血肿沿组织间隙扩散。不过这个思路没错：抗凝患者有腰部瘀斑和贫血时，如果血红蛋白继续下降或循环不稳，应做增强CT寻找腹膜后或活动性出血，再按 ACC 2020 共识评估严重程度。
feedback.en: Unlikely. The bruise and the mass centre on the left buttock, the onset followed the injection by a day and the ultrasound puts the collection about 36 mm beneath the skin, all pointing to a local source; the waist bruising is more likely the haematoma tracking along tissue planes. The instinct is sound, though: in an anticoagulated man with flank bruising and anaemia, a falling haemoglobin or unstable circulation calls for contrast CT to look for retroperitoneal or active bleeding, and a severity assessment by ACC 2020.

text.zh-CN: 注射后坏死性软组织感染：感染引起的凝血障碍既造成瘀斑扩大，也使 INR 升高
text.en: A necrotising soft-tissue infection after the injection, its coagulopathy causing both the spreading bruise and the high INR

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，但这是不能漏掉的诊断。它的线索是与体征不相称的剧痛、皮肤坏死或水疱、捻发音和全身中毒表现，本病例都没有记录；长期服用华法林的人 INR 6.2 也不需要另找原因。一旦怀疑就要急诊清创，所以要知道哪些表现会让你改变判断；即便如此，也要按 ACC 2020 共识先纠正凝血，再由外科处理。
feedback.en: No, but it is the diagnosis not to miss. Its clues — pain out of proportion, skin necrosis or blisters, crepitus and systemic toxicity — are none of them recorded here, and an INR of 6.2 in a man on long-term warfarin needs no second explanation. Suspicion means emergency debridement, so know which signs would change your mind; even then, correct the clotting first as ACC 2020 advises and let the surgeons act.

prompt.zh-CN: 你考虑是华法林抗凝过度时注射部位出血形成的血肿：INR 6.2，Hb 86 g/L，瘀斑仍在扩大，可能需要外科引流。他 5 年前换过主动脉瓣和二尖瓣，瓣膜类型和目标 INR 还不清楚。现在先怎么做？
prompt.en: You think this is a haematoma from bleeding at the injection site on excessive warfarin: INR 6.2, Hb 86 g/L, the bruise still spreading, and it may need surgical drainage. He had aortic and mitral valve replacements 5 years ago; the valve type and his target INR are not yet known. What do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先作答第 1 项决策，并问清他平时多久查一次凝血。
need.en: First answer decision 1 and find out how often his clotting is checked.

text.zh-CN: 停华法林，静脉缓慢输注维生素K₁ 5–10 mg 并按 INR 和体重给4因子PCC，复查 INR 纠正后再引流
text.en: Stop warfarin; vitamin K₁ 5–10 mg by slow IV infusion plus 4-factor PCC dosed by INR and weight; drain once a repeat INR shows correction

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ACC 2020 共识：需要干预的出血要停用华法林并静脉给维生素K；大出血经初始处理仍未控制时加用逆转药物，华法林的逆转首选4因子PCC（没有PCC时才用血浆；CHEST 2012 对大出血同样首选PCC而不是血浆）。瘀斑逐日扩大、Hb 86 g/L、很可能还要引流，应按此处理。PCC 立即补足凝血因子，维生素K需要数小时起效、负责维持；剂量超过需要并无好处，反而可能在日后重新抗凝时造成华法林抵抗，对人工瓣膜不利。引流前复查 INR，确认已经纠正。
feedback.en: Correct. ACC 2020 stops warfarin and gives IV vitamin K for a bleed that needs intervention, and adds a reversal agent when a major bleed does not settle — for warfarin, 4-factor PCC (plasma only when there is none; CHEST 2012 also prefers PCC to plasma in major bleeding). A haematoma whose bruise has spread day by day, with an Hb of 86 g/L and a likely drainage, is managed that way. PCC replaces the factors at once, while vitamin K takes hours and sustains the reversal; doses beyond what is needed add nothing and can cause warfarin resistance when he must be re-anticoagulated for his valves. Recheck the INR before any drainage.

text.zh-CN: 停用华法林，只用大剂量维生素K₁静脉注射，每天重复一次，直到 INR 完全恢复正常后再安排引流，不用凝血因子制剂
text.en: Stop warfarin and use high-dose IV vitamin K₁ alone, repeated daily until the INR is normal, then drain; no factor concentrate

feedback.zh-CN: 这接近原报告的做法（描述为大剂量维生素K，剂量未记录），但今天不应单独使用：维生素K需要数小时起效、约一天才充分，其间出血仍在继续，引流也只能等。CHEST 2012 建议华法林相关大出血用4因子PCC而不是血浆，并加用静脉维生素K。大剂量还会让恢复华法林后数天难以达标，对人工瓣膜不利。
feedback.en: Close to the report's course (described as high-dose vitamin K; the dose is not recorded), but not enough on its own today: vitamin K takes hours to act and about a day for full effect, while the bleeding goes on and the drainage waits. CHEST 2012 suggests 4-factor PCC rather than plasma for major bleeding on a vitamin K antagonist, with IV vitamin K added. High doses also make the INR hard to bring back into range when warfarin restarts — a problem with prosthetic valves.

text.zh-CN: 停用华法林，肌内注射维生素K₁ 10 mg，今天就在抗生素覆盖下切开引流，顺便排除脓肿
text.en: Stop warfarin, give vitamin K₁ 10 mg intramuscularly and incise and drain today under antibiotic cover to exclude an abscess

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。他的问题正是 INR 过高时肌注部位的出血；再肌注一针可能在新的部位出血，吸收也不可靠（NHS SPS 2023：INR 高于治疗范围时不应肌注）。在 INR 6.2 时切开会加重出血；先用静脉维生素K加PCC纠正凝血、复查 INR，再由外科决定是否引流（ACC 2020）。
feedback.en: Dangerous. His problem is bleeding at an IM injection site on a high INR; another IM injection can bleed at a new site and is erratically absorbed (NHS SPS 2023: no IM injection when the INR is above range). Incising at an INR of 6.2 makes the bleeding worse; correct the clotting with IV vitamin K and PCC, recheck the INR and let the surgeons decide on drainage (ACC 2020).

text.zh-CN: 停服华法林 1–2 次，口服维生素K₁ 1–2.5 mg，明天复查 INR，局部冷敷并观察肿块变化
text.en: Omit one or two doses of warfarin, give oral vitamin K₁ 1–2.5 mg, recheck the INR tomorrow and use cold packs while watching the mass

feedback.zh-CN: 不够。口服小剂量维生素K用于 INR 偏高但没有出血的患者——CHEST 2012 对 INR 4.5–10 且无出血者甚至不建议常规使用维生素K。他正在出血、瘀斑逐日扩大、已有贫血；口服起效太慢，引流前也纠正不了凝血（ACC 2020）。
feedback.en: Not enough. Low-dose oral vitamin K is for a high INR without bleeding — CHEST 2012 even suggests against routine vitamin K for an INR of 4.5–10 without bleeding. He is bleeding, the bruise has spread daily and he is anaemic; oral vitamin K is too slow, and the clotting would not be corrected before a drainage (ACC 2020).

text.zh-CN: 因为有两个人工瓣膜，华法林减量继续服用、不做逆转，用止痛药和冷敷，等血肿慢慢吸收
text.en: Because he has two prosthetic valves, continue warfarin at a lower dose without reversal, with analgesia and cold packs while the haematoma settles

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他的瓣膜确实需要长期抗凝，但在瘀斑仍在扩大、INR 6.2 时继续服药只会让出血继续。ACC 2020 共识：先停药、逆转、控制出血，止血可靠后再按血栓风险尽早恢复；人工瓣膜患者需要有计划地恢复，而不是在出血时继续用药。
feedback.en: No. His valves do need long-term anticoagulation, but carrying on at an INR of 6.2 while the bruise is still spreading feeds the bleeding. ACC 2020: stop, reverse and control the bleeding, then restart as soon as it is safe given the thrombotic risk; a prosthetic-valve patient needs a planned restart, not continued warfarin while he bleeds.

prompt.zh-CN: 按记录，华法林的作用被逆转之后，积液已在手术中引流。术后 Hb 58 g/L；他有主动脉瓣和二尖瓣置换史。现在怎样处理贫血？
prompt.en: As recorded, the collection was drained at an operation after the warfarin effect had been reversed. His post-operative Hb is 58 g/L, and he has had aortic and mitral valve replacements. How do you manage the anaemia now?

need.zh-CN: 先在记录终端看这一阶段新出的记录和血常规。
need.en: First read this stage's new records and blood count at a records terminal.

text.zh-CN: 现在输红细胞，每次 1 单位，每单位后评估症状、液体平衡和 Hb，并警惕循环超负荷
text.en: Transfuse red cells now, one unit at a time, reviewing symptoms, fluid balance and Hb after each unit and watching for overload

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。Hb 58 g/L 低于 AABB 2023 的限制性输血阈值（多数住院成人 70 g/L，合并心血管病者可用 80 g/L），应该输血。NICE NG24 建议没有活动性出血时每次输 1 单位、输后复评再决定下一单位；他的瓣膜病和重度贫血都是输血相关循环超负荷的危险因素，所以要记出入量、看血氧，必要时考虑利尿。同时检查引流部位，排除继续出血。
feedback.en: Correct. An Hb of 58 g/L is below the AABB 2023 restrictive thresholds (70 g/L for most hospitalised adults; 80 g/L may be used with cardiovascular disease), so he needs blood. NICE NG24 advises single units with review before the next when there is no active bleeding; his valve disease and severe anaemia both raise the risk of transfusion-associated circulatory overload, so chart fluid balance, watch the saturation and consider a diuretic. Check the drainage site for continued bleeding too.

text.zh-CN: 暂不输血：出血已经处理，静脉补铁并在一周后复查 Hb，可以完全避开输血的风险
text.en: Defer transfusion: the bleed has been dealt with, so give IV iron and recheck the Hb in a week, avoiding transfusion risks altogether

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。Hb 58 g/L、又有心脏瓣膜病，已低于 AABB 2023 的所有限制性阈值；静脉铁需要数周才能提升血红蛋白，不能替代此时的红细胞输注，只能作为之后的补充。
feedback.en: No. At 58 g/L with valve disease he is below every AABB 2023 restrictive threshold; IV iron takes weeks to raise the haemoglobin and cannot replace red cells now, though it may help later.

text.zh-CN: 快速连续输注 4 单位红细胞，把 Hb 尽快提到 100 g/L 以上，因为瓣膜病患者需要更高的血红蛋白
text.en: Run in 4 units of red cells quickly to lift the Hb above 100 g/L, since a patient with valve disease needs a higher haemoglobin

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。没有活动性大出血时快速大量输血，最容易让瓣膜病患者发生输血相关循环超负荷。AABB 2023 推荐限制性策略，并不以 100 g/L 为目标；NICE NG24 建议每次 1 单位、输后复评。
feedback.en: Dangerous. A rapid multi-unit transfusion without major active bleeding is the classic way to overload the circulation of a patient with valve disease. AABB 2023 recommends a restrictive strategy with no target of 100 g/L, and NICE NG24 advises one unit at a time with review.

text.zh-CN: 每输 1 单位红细胞同时输 1 单位新鲜冰冻血浆，补充凝血因子，防止引流部位再出血
text.en: Give a unit of fresh frozen plasma with each unit of red cells to replace clotting factors and stop the drainage site rebleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。凝血已经逆转、引流已经完成，常规配输血浆没有依据，只会增加容量负荷，还带来输血相关急性肺损伤和过敏的风险。怀疑继续出血时，先复查 INR、查看引流部位，再针对原因处理（ACC 2020）。
feedback.en: No. The clotting has been reversed and the drainage done; routine plasma with each unit has no basis and only adds volume, with risks of transfusion-related lung injury and allergy. If bleeding continues, recheck the INR and look at the drainage site, then treat the cause (ACC 2020).

prompt.zh-CN: 输血后他说胸口发闷、气短。他有主动脉瓣和二尖瓣置换史，这次住院中华法林的作用用药物逆转过。目前还没有任何观察数值。你先怎么做？
prompt.en: After the transfusion he says his chest feels tight and he is short of breath. He has aortic and mitral valve replacements, and his warfarin was reversed earlier in this admission. You have no observations yet. What do you do first?

need.zh-CN: 先在床旁问他现在哪里不舒服。
need.en: First ask him at the bedside how he feels now.

text.zh-CN: 停止输血、保留通路；评估生命体征、肺部和出入量并吸氧；超负荷时静注呋塞米；查胸片、心电图、BNP、心超并上报
text.en: Stop further transfusion, keep the line; assess vital signs, chest and fluid balance; oxygen; IV furosemide if overloaded; chest film, ECG, BNP, echo; report it

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。输血期间或输血后新出现的呼吸困难，先停止输血、评估，再找原因。ISBT 2018 对输血相关循环超负荷（TACO）的监测定义：输血期间或结束后 12 小时内出现呼吸窘迫或肺水肿，且总共满足至少 3 项标准，其余标准为心血管变化、液体超负荷和利钠肽升高；他有瓣膜病，TACO 可能性最大，利尿常能改善。但也要排除输血相关急性肺损伤、过敏或溶血反应，以及逆转华法林后人工瓣膜的血栓或功能障碍——所以要做超声心动图，并按输血不良反应上报。
feedback.en: Correct. New breathlessness during or after a transfusion means stop, assess, then find the cause. The ISBT 2018 surveillance definition of transfusion-associated circulatory overload (TACO) needs respiratory compromise or pulmonary oedema during or within 12 hours of transfusion and at least three criteria in all, the others being cardiovascular changes, fluid overload and a raised natriuretic peptide; with his valve disease TACO is the likeliest, and a diuretic often helps. But exclude lung injury, an allergic or haemolytic reaction and, after the reversal of his warfarin, prosthetic-valve thrombosis or dysfunction — hence the echo — and report the reaction.

text.zh-CN: 把输血速度调慢，先把这一单位血输完再评估；输血时胸闷多半是紧张，先安慰他，等这单位输完后再复测生命体征
text.en: Slow the rate and finish the unit before assessing him; tightness during a transfusion is usually anxiety, so reassure him and repeat his observations at the end

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。在弄清原因前继续输血，可能让循环超负荷或输血反应加重，等输完再测生命体征也太迟；任何新出现的呼吸症状都要先停止输血、评估（ISBT 2018 的 TACO 定义把输血后 12 小时内新出现的呼吸窘迫列为必备条件之一）。紧张只能在排除其他原因之后才考虑。
feedback.en: No. Carrying on before the cause is known can push overload or a transfusion reaction further, and observations at the end come too late; any new respiratory symptom means stopping and assessing first (the ISBT 2018 TACO definition counts new respiratory compromise up to 12 hours after a transfusion). Anxiety is a diagnosis of exclusion.

text.zh-CN: 按过敏反应处理：静脉注射氢化可的松和氯苯那敏，查看皮肤并复测生命体征，等症状缓解后再继续把余下的血输完
text.en: Treat it as an allergic reaction with IV hydrocortisone and chlorphenamine, look at his skin and observations, and carry on with the transfusion once he settles

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。过敏反应确实可能，但本病例没有记录荨麻疹、喘鸣或低血压；未经评估就按过敏处理并继续输血，可能漏掉瓣膜病患者身上更可能的循环超负荷（ISBT 2018 TACO 定义）。真正的严重过敏反应需要停止输血并肌注肾上腺素，而不是只给激素和抗组胺药。
feedback.en: No. An allergic reaction is possible, but no urticaria, wheeze or hypotension is recorded, and assuming allergy and carrying on risks missing circulatory overload, the likelier cause in a man with valve disease (ISBT 2018 TACO definition). True anaphylaxis would mean stopping the transfusion and giving IM adrenaline, not steroids and an antihistamine alone.

text.zh-CN: 诊断为输血相关急性肺损伤：停止输血，给大剂量糖皮质激素并静脉补液，避免使用利尿剂，把血袋退回输血科检测
text.en: Diagnose transfusion-related acute lung injury: stop the unit, give high-dose corticosteroids and IV fluids, avoid diuretics and return the bag to the blood bank for testing

feedback.zh-CN: 不对——停止输血、退回血袋是对的，其余不对。输血相关急性肺损伤（TRALI）和循环超负荷（TACO）的处理方向相反：TRALI 以支持治疗为主，TACO 需要利尿；在评估、胸片、BNP 和超声心动图排查他身上更可能的循环超负荷之前，不能直接认定是 TRALI（ISBT 2018 TACO 定义）。糖皮质激素对 TRALI 没有确切疗效，盲目补液对瓣膜病患者尤其危险。
feedback.en: No — stopping the unit and returning the bag are right; the rest is not. TRALI and TACO pull treatment in opposite directions (supportive care for TRALI, a diuretic for TACO), and TRALI cannot be called before the assessment, chest film, BNP and echo have looked for overload, the likelier cause in him (ISBT 2018 TACO definition). Corticosteroids have no proven benefit in TRALI, and giving fluids blindly is especially dangerous with valve disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 接下来要规划抗凝：他 5 年前换了主动脉瓣和二尖瓣，长期服用华法林，平时大约半年才查一次凝血；这次肌注部位出血，入院时 INR 6.2。什么时候、怎样恢复抗凝？今后要改变什么？
prompt.en: Now plan his anticoagulation: aortic and mitral valve replacements 5 years ago, long-term warfarin with clotting checked about every six months, and a bleed at an IM injection site, with an INR of 6.2 on admission. When and how should anticoagulation restart, and what must change afterwards?

need.zh-CN: 先作答第 4 项决策，并问清换瓣手术、华法林和凝血监测的情况。
need.en: First answer decision 4, and find out about the valve surgery, the warfarin and how his clotting has been monitored.

text.zh-CN: 核实瓣膜类型和目标 INR，止血可靠后尽早恢复（机械瓣以肝素过渡），之后至少每 4 周查 INR、不再肌注
text.en: Confirm the valve type and target INR, restart once haemostasis is secure (heparin bridge if mechanical), then INR at least 4-weekly and no IM injections

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ACC 2020 共识：出血来源已控制、又不是关键器官出血时，应在医学上安全后尽早恢复抗凝。目标取决于瓣膜：ACC/AHA 2020 对机械二尖瓣的目标 INR 为 3.0、无危险因素的机械主动脉瓣为 2.5，机械二尖瓣中断华法林时用肝素过渡是合理的（2a 类）；国内中心的目标范围可能更低，应按他的瓣膜团队设定的目标执行。CHEST 2012 只允许 INR 一直稳定的患者把监测间隔延长到最多 12 周，半年一次远远不够。
feedback.en: Correct. ACC 2020: when the source is controlled and the bleed was not in a critical organ, restart anticoagulation as soon as it is medically safe. The target depends on the valves: ACC/AHA 2020 sets INR 3.0 for a mechanical mitral valve and 2.5 for a mechanical aortic valve without risk factors, and makes heparin bridging reasonable for a mechanical mitral valve when warfarin is interrupted (class 2a); Chinese centres may use lower ranges, so follow the target his valve team set. CHEST 2012 lets only consistently stable patients stretch INR checks to 12 weeks — six-monthly is far too few.

text.zh-CN: 这次出血说明他不适合华法林：永久停用，改为长期服用阿司匹林，每年复查一次心脏超声
text.en: This bleed shows warfarin is unsafe for him: stop it for good and use long-term aspirin, with a yearly echocardiogram of the valves

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。如果是机械瓣，单用阿司匹林不能预防瓣膜血栓和栓塞，必须终身用华法林（ACC/AHA 2020）。一次原因明确的出血（服华法林期间肌注，入院时 INR 6.2）应该纠正原因，而不是放弃抗凝。
feedback.en: No. If his valves are mechanical, aspirin alone does not prevent valve thrombosis or embolism, and warfarin is required for life (ACC/AHA 2020). A bleed with an obvious cause — an IM injection in a man on warfarin whose INR, when checked, was 6.2 — calls for fixing the cause, not abandoning anticoagulation.

text.zh-CN: 改用利伐沙班或阿哌沙班：出血风险更低，也不用监测 INR，出院那天直接换药即可
text.en: Switch to rivaroxaban or apixaban, which bleed less and need no INR checks, changing over on the day of discharge

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。ACC/AHA 2020 把直接口服抗凝药用于机械瓣列为 3 类（有害）：在机械瓣患者的试验中，血栓栓塞事件多于华法林。先核实瓣膜类型；机械瓣只能用华法林。
feedback.en: Dangerous. ACC/AHA 2020 rates direct oral anticoagulants with mechanical valves class 3 (harm): in trials with mechanical valves they caused more thromboembolic events than warfarin. Confirm the valve type first; a mechanical valve means warfarin.

text.zh-CN: 等瘀斑完全消退（约 1 个月）再恢复华法林，目标 INR 下调到 1.5 左右，以后仍然每半年复查一次凝血
text.en: Wait until the bruising has gone, about a month, then restart warfarin with the target lowered to about 1.5 and keep the clotting checks six-monthly as before

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。如果是机械瓣，一个月不抗凝、又把目标降到 1.5 左右，会让两个人工瓣膜（尤其二尖瓣位）面临很高的血栓风险；对服用华法林的人来说，半年查一次 INR 也远远不够。ACC 2020 共识主张止血后尽早恢复，CHEST 2012 的监测间隔最长也只有 12 周。
feedback.en: No. If his valves are mechanical, a month without anticoagulation and a target near 1.5 expose them — the mitral above all — to a high risk of thrombosis; and six-monthly INR checks are far too few for anyone on warfarin. ACC 2020 restarts as soon as haemostasis allows, and CHEST 2012 never stretches monitoring beyond 12 weeks.

text.zh-CN: 问清起病经过：感冒时肌注安乃近、次日开始不适、瘀斑逐日扩大、躺坐时疼痛加重
text.en: Took the story: the metamizole injection for a cold, trouble from the next day, a bruise spreading daily and pain worse lying or sitting

text.zh-CN: 问清抗凝背景：换瓣手术和瓣膜类型、华法林及其剂量、凝血监测频率、其他用药和别处出血
text.en: Took the anticoagulation history: the valve surgery and valve type, warfarin and its dose, how often the INR is checked, other medicines and bleeding elsewhere

text.zh-CN: 查看了双侧臀部和腰部的瘀斑，触诊了肿块的大小、压痛和皮温
text.en: Inspected the bruising over both buttocks and the waist and felt the swelling for size, tenderness and warmth

text.zh-CN: 开立并查看了凝血功能、血常规和臀部超声，并做了血型鉴定与交叉配血
text.en: Ordered and read the clotting screen, the blood count and the buttock ultrasound, and sent a group and crossmatch

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为抗凝过度时注射部位出血形成的血肿
text.en: Identified bleeding at the injection site on excessive anticoagulation at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 在送去引流之前停用华法林，并给予静脉维生素K₁和凝血因子制剂（首选PCC）
text.en: Before the drainage, stopped warfarin and gave IV vitamin K₁ with a clotting-factor product (PCC first choice)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对逆转方案，用了PCC而不是血浆，并在引流前复查了 INR
text.en: Chose the reversal plan at the first attempt, used PCC rather than plasma and rechecked the INR before the drainage

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对术后输血的方式，并逐单位输注、输后复评
text.en: Chose how to transfuse after the operation at the first attempt and gave red cells unit by unit with review

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确处理输血后气短：停止继续输血，并申请了胸片和超声心动图查找原因
text.en: Handled the breathlessness after the transfusion correctly at the first attempt, stopped further transfusion and asked for a chest film and an echocardiogram

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即规划好恢复抗凝与预防，并向他讲解了抗凝注意事项
text.en: Planned the restart of anticoagulation and its prevention correctly at the first attempt and gave him the anticoagulation advice

text.zh-CN: 没有做危险的事：没有在床旁穿刺或切开肿块，没有在补充凝血因子前送去引流，没有再做肌内注射（维生素K₁或止痛针），没有快速大量输血，也没有改用直接口服抗凝药
text.en: Did nothing dangerous: no bedside needle or incision, no drainage before clotting factors were replaced, no further intramuscular injection (vitamin K₁ or a painkiller), no rapid multi-unit transfusion and no switch to a direct oral anticoagulant

text.zh-CN: 向他解释出血的原因、停用和逆转华法林的理由、恢复抗凝的计划和预防办法，并确认他听懂
text.en: Explained to him why he bled, why warfarin is stopped and reversed, the plan to restart it and how to prevent a repeat, and checked his understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按 Calgary–Cambridge 的解释与计划环节评估。良好表现：先问他已经知道什么、最担心什么（他怕停华法林会让换的瓣膜出事），用通俗的话分段说明——这次查出他的血太稀（INR 过高），打针的地方出血形成了大血块；现在暂停华法林、用药把凝血纠正过来是为了止血，是暂时的；止血可靠后会尽早恢复，以保护瓣膜，瓣膜类型和目标值要和他的瓣膜医生核实；输血可能引起气短，有不适要马上说；以后不再接受肌内注射、至少每 4 周查一次 INR、看病和买药都说明自己在吃华法林。每段之后确认他听懂（请他用自己的话复述），回应他的担忧，不作虚假保证，不说病例中没有记录的事（例如瓣膜类型）。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the explanation-and-planning part of Calgary–Cambridge. Good performance: first ask what he already knows and what worries him most (he fears that stopping warfarin will harm his new valves), then explain in plain words, a piece at a time — his blood was found to be far too thin (INR too high), and the injection site bled into a large clot; stopping warfarin and correcting the clotting now is to stop the bleeding and is temporary; it will be restarted as soon as the bleeding is controlled, to protect his valves, and the valve type and his target range will be checked with his valve doctors; a transfusion can cause breathlessness, so he should say at once if he feels unwell; in future no intramuscular injections, an INR check at least every 4 weeks, and telling every doctor and pharmacist he takes warfarin. Check understanding after each piece (teach-back), respond to his worry, give no false reassurance and claim nothing the case does not record (such as the valve type).

name.zh-CN: 廖医生（心内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只就学员已经拿到的资料提问，按 PEARLS 复盘。第 1 项决策前只问鉴别：“长期吃华法林的人，打针后第二天开始出现肿块、青紫一天比一天大，首先要想到什么？白细胞高和局部发热能说明什么、不能说明什么？”“哪些发现会让你担心深部或腹膜后出血？”作答后再深入：“按 ACC 2020 的四条标准，这次出血现在能判断到哪一步？哪一条因为缺少之前的血红蛋白而判断不了？”“维生素K为什么要静脉给、不能肌注？PCC 和血浆各有什么利弊，对瓣膜病人呢？”“送去引流之前你要看到什么？”“术后输血输多少、怎么输？”“输血后胸闷气短要排除哪些原因？为什么要看人工瓣膜？”“瓣膜类型不清楚时，怎么定恢复抗凝的时机和方式？为什么不能换成新型口服抗凝药？”“半年查一次凝血和感冒肌注，各暴露了什么问题？”可以讲解 ACC 2020、CHEST 2012、ACC/AHA 2020、AABB 2023、NICE NG24、ISBT 2018 和 NHS SPS 2023 的相关原则，并把原报告的历史处置与现行做法对照。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的数据（生命体征、血小板、瓣膜类型、华法林剂量、维生素K剂量、输血量和心衰治疗都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has and debriefs with PEARLS. Before decision 1, only the differential: “In a man on long-term warfarin, what do a swelling and a bruise that start the day after an injection, the bruise spreading daily, suggest first? What can a raised white count and local warmth show, and what can they not?”, “Which findings would make you worry about a deep or retroperitoneal bleed?” After the learner commits, go deeper: “How far can you classify this bleed by the four ACC 2020 criteria — and which one can you not judge without an earlier haemoglobin?”, “Why vitamin K intravenously and never into the muscle? PCC or plasma — and for a man with valve disease?”, “What do you need to see before he goes for drainage?”, “How much blood after the operation, and how?”, “What must you exclude when he becomes breathless after the transfusion, and why look at the prosthetic valves?”, “With the valve type unknown, how do you set the timing and route of the restart, and why not a DOAC?”, “What did six-monthly clotting checks and an injection for a cold each expose?” May explain the relevant principles of ACC 2020, CHEST 2012, ACC/AHA 2020, AABB 2023, NICE NG24, ISBT 2018 and NHS SPS 2023, contrasting the reported course with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, platelets, the valve type, the warfarin and vitamin K doses, the volume transfused and the heart-failure treatment are not recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房责任护士。用 ISBAR 交班：秦知远，51岁男性，今天收入病房；8 天前打过一针，之后左臀部肿痛，瘀斑一天天扩大；请来看他。病房有治疗车（静脉通路和药品）、氧气、输液泵和心电图机；床旁超声、床旁胸片和心脏超声要从影像科叫来；血型和交叉配血要先抽血送输血科；凝血酶原复合物和维生素K₁从药房取；输血按医院规范在开始、输注中和结束时观察。复述医嘱；只报告已经测到或已经出结果的数值，不解读、不作诊断。被问到入院时、术后或输血前后的生命体征，如实说病历里找不到记录。
knowledge.en: The ward nurse. ISBAR handover: Qin Zhiyuan, 51, admitted today; after an injection 8 days ago his left buttock became swollen and painful and the bruise has spread day by day; please see him. On the ward: the treatment cart (IV access and drugs), oxygen, infusion pumps and an ECG machine; the bedside ultrasound, portable chest film and echo are called from imaging; a group and crossmatch needs blood sent to the blood bank; PCC and vitamin K₁ come from pharmacy; transfusions follow the hospital policy with observations at the start, during and at the end. Reads orders back, reports values only once they have been measured or the result is back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for his vital signs on admission, after the operation or around the transfusion, she says plainly that she cannot find them charted.

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师，只解读学员已经看过的凝血结果。可以讲解：华法林治疗中 INR 升高的常见原因（新用的药、急性病、进食减少、剂量错误、监测间隔过长），但不替本例下结论；维生素K₁要缓慢静脉输注、不肌注，剂量过大会让日后重新抗凝时出现华法林抵抗；ACC 2020 按 INR 和体重给4因子PCC的剂量分档；血浆的容量问题；规律服用对乙酰氨基酚也可使 INR 升高，非甾体抗炎药增加出血；国家药品监督管理局 2020 年已注销安乃近注射液的注册证书；直接口服抗凝药不能用于机械瓣；恢复华法林后的监测频率和抗凝卡。如实说明他的华法林剂量、其他用药和既往 INR 在病历里都找不到；不提前说出诊断。
knowledge.en: The clinical pharmacist, who interprets only the clotting results the learner has read. Can explain the common reasons an INR rises on warfarin (a new drug, an acute illness, eating less, a dosing error, checks too far apart) without deciding which applied here; that vitamin K₁ is infused slowly IV, never given into the muscle, and that large doses cause warfarin resistance when he is re-anticoagulated; the ACC 2020 PCC dose bands by INR and weight; the volume problem with plasma; that regular paracetamol can also raise the INR and NSAIDs add to bleeding; that China's National Medical Products Administration cancelled the registration of metamizole injection in 2020; that DOACs must not be used with mechanical valves; and the monitoring and anticoagulation card after warfarin restarts. Says plainly that his warfarin dose, other medicines and earlier INR results cannot be found in the notes, and never states the diagnosis early.

knowledge.zh-CN: 普通外科医生，只解读学员已经看过的超声和引流术记录。可以讲解：超声上血肿和脓肿的表现可以很相似，积液内部的回声既可能是血凝块也可能是脓液，单凭超声不能可靠区分；软组织血肿什么时候需要引流（持续扩大、皮肤受压或坏死、压迫神经、怀疑感染），以及为什么要先纠正凝血、复查 INR；有活动性出血时可用增强CT寻找出血点并考虑介入栓塞；臀部大血肿要检查下肢的感觉和运动（坐骨神经受压），本病例没有记录这项检查。如实说明手术的时间、麻醉方式、引流量和培养结果都没有记录；第 1 项决策之前不说出诊断，不解读结局记录。
knowledge.en: A general surgeon who interprets only the ultrasound and the drainage record the learner has read. Can explain that a haematoma and an abscess can look alike on ultrasound — echoes inside a collection may be clot or pus — so ultrasound alone cannot reliably tell them apart; when a soft-tissue haematoma needs drainage (still expanding, skin under tension or breaking down, nerve compression, suspected infection) and why the clotting is corrected and the INR rechecked first; that contrast CT can look for a bleeding point and guide embolisation when bleeding is active; and that a large buttock haematoma calls for a check of leg sensation and power (sciatic nerve compression), which this case does not record. Says plainly that the timing, anaesthesia, volume drained and culture result of the operation are not recorded; does not name the diagnosis before decision 1 and does not interpret the outcome record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：华法林抗凝过度时肌注引起的臀部血肿
title.en: Debrief: a buttock haematoma after an intramuscular injection on excessive warfarin

conclusion.zh-CN: 51岁男性，5 年前换过主动脉瓣和二尖瓣，长期服用华法林，约半年才查一次凝血。感冒时肌注安乃近，次日起左臀部肿痛，瘀斑逐日扩大到部分右臀和左腰；左臀约 150×50 mm 压痛肿块，局部稍热。INR 6.2，APTT 42.5 s，Hb 86 g/L，WBC 24.7×10⁹/L；超声见约 139×55 mm 不规则低回声区，内有絮状回声——华法林抗凝过度时肌注部位出血形成的血肿，伴失血性贫血。原团队逆转华法林（描述为大剂量维生素K，剂量未记录）后手术引流，见血凝块而非脓液；术后 Hb 降至 58 g/L，输血后胸闷气短，被考虑为心力衰竭，治疗后缓解；此后恢复华法林，1 个月时瘀斑消退，INR 2.1。按现行指南：立即停用华法林，静脉维生素K₁加4因子PCC，复查 INR 后再引流（ACC 2020）；按限制性阈值输血（AABB 2023），每次 1 单位、输后复评并警惕循环超负荷（NICE NG24）；核实瓣膜类型后尽早恢复抗凝，机械瓣不用直接口服抗凝药（ACC/AHA 2020）。
conclusion.en: A 51-year-old man on warfarin since aortic and mitral valve replacements 5 years before, with clotting checked about six-monthly, got IM metamizole for a cold. Next day the left buttock swelled and hurt, with a bruise spreading daily to part of the right buttock and the left waist and a tender, mildly warm mass of about 150×50 mm. INR 6.2, APTT 42.5 s, Hb 86 g/L, WBC 24.7×10⁹/L; ultrasound: irregular hypoechoic area of about 139×55 mm with flocculent echoes — an injection-site haematoma on excessive warfarin, with blood-loss anaemia. After reversal (described as high-dose vitamin K; dose not recorded) drainage found clot, not pus; Hb fell to 58 g/L; breathlessness after a transfusion, considered heart failure, improved with treatment. Warfarin was resumed; at one month the bruise had gone, INR 2.1. Today: stop warfarin, IV vitamin K and 4-factor PCC, drain after a repeat INR (ACC 2020); transfuse below the restrictive threshold (AABB 2023), one unit at a time with review, watching for overload (NICE NG24); early restart, no DOAC for a mechanical valve (ACC/AHA 2020).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 长期服用华法林的人，打针后第二天开始出现肿块、青紫一天比一天大，首先要想到出血：INR 6.2 说明为什么会出血，Hb 86 g/L 说明已经贫血（没有此前的数值，算不出下降了多少）。
keyReasoning.en: In a man on long-term warfarin, a swelling and a bruise that start the day after an injection, the bruise spreading daily, are bleeding until shown otherwise: the INR of 6.2 explains why, and an Hb of 86 g/L shows he is already anaemic (with no earlier value, the size of the fall cannot be measured).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 白细胞 24.7×10⁹/L 和局部稍热不能证明脓肿，大血肿也可以这样；有没有脓，要等凝血纠正后由外科来回答，而不是在 INR 6.2 时用针去验证。
keyReasoning.en: A WBC of 24.7×10⁹/L and mild warmth do not prove an abscess — a large haematoma can do the same; whether there is pus is answered by the surgeons once the clotting is corrected, not by a needle at an INR of 6.2.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 逆转的强度要与出血相称：瘀斑仍在扩大、已有贫血、可能需要引流的出血，需要补充凝血因子加静脉维生素K，而不是 INR 偏高但没有出血时的口服小剂量。
keyReasoning.en: Reversal is matched to the bleed: one whose bruise is still spreading, with anaemia and a possible drainage, needs clotting factors plus IV vitamin K, not the small oral dose used for a high INR without bleeding.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 两个人工瓣膜让停药成为短期的权衡：现在停、现在逆转，但从一开始就要计划尽早恢复——瓣膜类型和目标 INR 决定恢复的时机和方式。
keyReasoning.en: Two prosthetic valves make stopping warfarin a short-term trade-off: stop and reverse now, but plan the restart from the start — the valve type and target INR decide when and how.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 瓣膜病患者输血后新出现气短，先停、再评估：循环超负荷最常见，但输血相关急性肺损伤、过敏反应，以及逆转后人工瓣膜的血栓或功能障碍都要排除。
keyReasoning.en: New breathlessness after a transfusion in a man with valve disease means stop, then assess: circulatory overload is the commonest cause, but lung injury, allergy and, after the reversal, prosthetic-valve thrombosis or dysfunction must be excluded.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 这次暴露了两个可以预防的环节：半年才查一次 INR，危险的高值可能一直没人发现；以及在服用华法林时肌注止痛退热药。
keyReasoning.en: Two preventable steps stand out: INR checks only every six months, which can leave a dangerous INR unseen, and an injected analgesic given to a man on warfarin.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是 2014 年发表的一例历史个案，不能说明 INR 为什么升到 6.2，也不能确定输血后气短的机制；单个病例不能证明任何一种逆转或输血方案的效果。本病例没有记录生命体征、血小板、瓣膜类型、华法林和维生素K的剂量、输血量和心衰治疗；病例中的决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。患者事实沿用 1.0.0 版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对。
boundaries.en: This is a single historical case published in 2014; it cannot show why the INR reached 6.2 or establish the mechanism of the breathlessness after the transfusion, and one case cannot prove the value of any reversal or transfusion strategy. The case records no vital signs, platelet count, valve type, warfarin or vitamin K dose, transfusion volume or heart-failure treatment; its decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the published course. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article.

unknowns.zh-CN: 所换瓣膜的类型（机械瓣或生物瓣）、型号和他的目标 INR 范围，以及有没有房颤等其他抗凝指征。
unknowns.en: The type of the replacement valves (mechanical or tissue), their model and his target INR range, and whether he has another reason for anticoagulation such as atrial fibrillation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 华法林的剂量、这次生病前最近一次 INR、其他用药（包括感冒期间的用药）、饮食和饮酒——也就是 INR 为什么升到 6.2。
unknowns.en: His warfarin dose, his last INR before this illness, his other medicines (including any for the cold), diet and alcohol — that is, why the INR reached 6.2.

unknowns.zh-CN: 安乃近的剂量、注射在哪一侧（臀部系据报告标题推断），以及一共打了几针。
unknowns.en: The metamizole dose, the side of the injection (the buttock is inferred from the report's title), and how many injections he had.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院时的生命体征和体温、血小板计数、肝肾功能，以及别处有无出血。
unknowns.en: His vital signs and temperature on admission, platelet count, liver and renal function, and any bleeding elsewhere.

unknowns.zh-CN: 逆转的细节：维生素K的剂量和途径，是否用过血浆或凝血酶原复合物，以及引流前的 INR。
unknowns.en: The details of the reversal: the vitamin K dose and route, whether plasma or PCC was used, and the INR before the drainage.

unknowns.zh-CN: 引流手术的时间、麻醉方式、引流量和培养结果。
unknowns.en: The timing, anaesthesia, volume drained and culture result of the drainage operation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 输血的血制品、单位数和速度；气短时的生命体征、查体、胸片、BNP、超声心动图和所用的治疗。
unknowns.en: The blood product, number of units and rate of the transfusion; the vital signs, examination, chest film, BNP, echocardiogram and treatment during the breathlessness.

unknowns.zh-CN: 恢复华法林的时间和剂量、是否用肝素过渡、为他设定的目标 INR，以及 1 个月以后的随访。
unknowns.en: When and at what dose warfarin was restarted, whether heparin bridged the gap, the target INR set for him, and any follow-up after one month.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 出血严重程度与逆转。ACC 2020 共识把下列任一情况定为大出血：关键部位出血、血流动力学不稳定、Hb 下降 ≥ 20 g/L，或需要输注 ≥ 2 单位红细胞；大出血经初始处理仍未控制时加用逆转药物。本病例没有记录他此前的 Hb，但瘀斑逐日扩大、Hb 86 g/L、很可能需要引流，应按此处理：停用华法林，静脉缓慢输注维生素K₁ 5–10 mg，按 INR 和体重给4因子PCC（INR > 6 时 50 IU/kg），没有PCC时才用血浆 10–15 mL/kg，引流前复查 INR。历史与现行：记录中引流前的逆转所用维生素K描述为大剂量（剂量未记录）；今天以PCC为主，维生素K给到够用即可。
teachingPoints.en: Severity and reversal. ACC 2020 calls a bleed major if it involves a critical site, causes haemodynamic instability, drops the Hb by ≥ 20 g/L or needs ≥ 2 units of red cells, and adds a reversal agent when a major bleed does not settle with the first measures. His earlier Hb is not recorded, but a bleed whose bruise has spread daily, with an Hb of 86 g/L and a drainage likely, is treated as such: stop warfarin, give vitamin K₁ 5–10 mg by slow IV infusion and 4-factor PCC by INR and weight (50 IU/kg when the INR is above 6), plasma 10–15 mL/kg only when there is no PCC, and recheck the INR before drainage. Then and now: the recorded reversal before the drainage used vitamin K described as high-dose (dose not recorded); today PCC leads and vitamin K is given only in the dose needed.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 抗凝患者的给药途径。NHS SPS 2023：服用华法林的人最近一次 INR 应在治疗范围内，INR 高于治疗范围时不应肌注；先考虑其他给药途径——维生素K₁同样不肌注，ACC 2020 采用静脉给药。感冒发热止痛首选口服对乙酰氨基酚，避免非甾体抗炎药。历史与现行：本例在华法林治疗中因感冒肌注安乃近，而凝血约半年才查一次；国家药品监督管理局 2020 年已因严重不良反应（包括粒细胞缺乏症）注销安乃近注射液的注册证书，今天国内已不再使用这种注射液。
teachingPoints.en: Routes in anticoagulated patients. NHS SPS 2023: a patient on warfarin should have a recent INR within range, and no IM injection is given when the INR is above the therapeutic range; consider another route first — so vitamin K₁ is not given into the muscle either; ACC 2020 gives it IV. For a cold or fever, oral paracetamol, not an NSAID. Then and now: he was given IM metamizole for a cold while on warfarin with clotting checked about six-monthly; in 2020 China's National Medical Products Administration cancelled the registration of metamizole injection for serious adverse reactions, agranulocytosis among them, so the injection is no longer used there.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 瓣膜病患者的输血。AABB 2023：血流动力学稳定的住院成人在 Hb < 70 g/L 时考虑输血，合并心血管病者可采用 80 g/L；他术后 Hb 58 g/L，需要输血。NICE NG24（2015）：没有活动性出血时每次输 1 单位，输后评估并复查 Hb 再决定是否继续。瓣膜病和重度贫血都增加输血相关循环超负荷的风险：控制速度、记录出入量、观察血氧，必要时用利尿剂。历史与现行：本病例只记录了输血，没有记录血制品、单位数和速度。
teachingPoints.en: Transfusing a patient with valve disease. AABB 2023: consider transfusion at an Hb below 70 g/L in stable hospitalised adults, with 80 g/L an option in cardiovascular disease; at 58 g/L after the operation he needed blood. NICE NG24 (2015): without active bleeding give one unit, then reassess and recheck the Hb before the next. Valve disease and severe anaemia both raise the risk of transfusion-associated circulatory overload: control the rate, chart fluid balance, watch the saturation and consider a diuretic. Then and now: this case records the transfusion but not the product, units or rate.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 输血后的气短。ISBT 2018 对输血相关循环超负荷（TACO）的监测定义：输血期间或结束后 12 小时内出现急性或加重的呼吸窘迫或肺水肿，且 5 项标准中总共满足至少 3 项（其余为心血管变化、液体超负荷、利钠肽升高）。处理：停止继续输血、吸氧、利尿，查胸片、心电图、BNP 和超声心动图，并按输血不良反应上报；同时排除输血相关急性肺损伤、过敏或溶血反应，以及逆转华法林后人工瓣膜的血栓或功能障碍。历史与现行：原团队考虑为心力衰竭，治疗后缓解；今天应按可能的 TACO 评估并上报。
teachingPoints.en: Breathlessness after a transfusion. The ISBT 2018 surveillance definition of TACO: acute or worsening respiratory compromise or pulmonary oedema during or within 12 hours of transfusion, and at least three of its five criteria in all (the others: cardiovascular changes, fluid overload, a raised natriuretic peptide). Stop further transfusion, give oxygen and a diuretic, get a chest film, ECG, BNP and echo, and report the reaction; exclude lung injury, an allergic or haemolytic reaction and, after the reversal, prosthetic-valve thrombosis or dysfunction. Then and now: the team considered heart failure and it improved with treatment; today it would be assessed and reported as possible TACO.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 恢复抗凝。ACC 2020 共识：出血来源已控制、又不是关键器官出血时，医学上安全后尽早恢复抗凝。ACC/AHA 2020：机械二尖瓣目标 INR 3.0，无危险因素的机械主动脉瓣 2.5（有危险因素 3.0）；机械二尖瓣中断华法林时用肝素过渡是合理的（2a 类）；直接口服抗凝药对机械瓣有害（3 类）。国内中心使用的目标范围可能更低，应以他的瓣膜团队设定的目标为准；若为生物瓣，是否需要长期抗凝取决于其他指征。历史与现行：本病例记录恢复了华法林，1 个月时 INR 2.1；瓣膜类型、目标范围、恢复时间和是否过渡都没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Restarting anticoagulation. ACC 2020: when the source is controlled and the bleed was not in a critical organ, restart as soon as it is medically safe. ACC/AHA 2020: target INR 3.0 for a mechanical mitral valve and 2.5 for a mechanical aortic valve without risk factors (3.0 with them); heparin bridging is reasonable for a mechanical mitral valve when warfarin is interrupted (class 2a); DOACs are harmful with mechanical valves (class 3). Chinese centres may use lower ranges, so follow the target his valve team set; with tissue valves, long-term anticoagulation depends on other indications. Then and now: warfarin was resumed and the INR was 2.1 at one month; the valve type, target, timing and any bridging are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: INR 监测。CHEST 2012：只有 INR 一直稳定的患者，监测间隔才可延长到最多 12 周（2B 级）；本例约半年才查一次，远超这一上限，INR 升高可能很久都没人发现。出血后恢复华法林的头几周应每周查，稳定后至少每 4 周一次；经过培训、能胜任的患者可以自我管理 INR（CHEST 2012）。每次看病、用新药，都要告诉医生和药师自己在服用华法林。
teachingPoints.en: INR monitoring. CHEST 2012: only patients with consistently stable INRs may stretch testing to at most 12 weeks (grade 2B); his roughly six-monthly checks were far beyond that, so a rising INR could go unnoticed for months. After a bleed, check weekly for the first weeks of the restart, then at least every 4 weeks once stable; trained, competent patients can self-manage their INR (CHEST 2012). He should tell every doctor and pharmacist, and check every new medicine, that he takes warfarin.

unknowns.zh-CN: 所换瓣膜的类型（机械瓣或生物瓣）、型号和他的目标 INR 范围，以及有没有房颤等其他抗凝指征。
unknowns.en: The type of the replacement valves (mechanical or tissue), their model and his target INR range, and whether he has another reason for anticoagulation such as atrial fibrillation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 华法林的剂量、这次生病前最近一次 INR、其他用药（包括感冒期间的用药）、饮食和饮酒——也就是 INR 为什么升到 6.2。
unknowns.en: His warfarin dose, his last INR before this illness, his other medicines (including any for the cold), diet and alcohol — that is, why the INR reached 6.2.

unknowns.zh-CN: 安乃近的剂量、注射在哪一侧（臀部系据报告标题推断），以及一共打了几针。
unknowns.en: The metamizole dose, the side of the injection (the buttock is inferred from the report's title), and how many injections he had.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院时的生命体征和体温、血小板计数、肝肾功能，以及别处有无出血。
unknowns.en: His vital signs and temperature on admission, platelet count, liver and renal function, and any bleeding elsewhere.

unknowns.zh-CN: 逆转的细节：维生素K的剂量和途径，是否用过血浆或凝血酶原复合物，以及引流前的 INR。
unknowns.en: The details of the reversal: the vitamin K dose and route, whether plasma or PCC was used, and the INR before the drainage.

unknowns.zh-CN: 引流手术的时间、麻醉方式、引流量和培养结果。
unknowns.en: The timing, anaesthesia, volume drained and culture result of the drainage operation.

unknowns.zh-CN: 输血的血制品、单位数和速度；气短时的生命体征、查体、胸片、BNP、超声心动图和所用的治疗。
unknowns.en: The blood product, number of units and rate of the transfusion; the vital signs, examination, chest film, BNP, echocardiogram and treatment during the breathlessness.

unknowns.zh-CN: 恢复华法林的时间和剂量、是否用肝素过渡、为他设定的目标 INR，以及 1 个月以后的随访。
unknowns.en: When and at what dose warfarin was restarted, whether heparin bridged the gap, the target INR set for him, and any follow-up after one month.
